newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Feedgrain seeks 52,000T of corn.
newsitem.headline: Korea Feedgrain seeks 52,000T of corn.

text.p: Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee (KFPC) invited on Wednesday tenders for 52,000 tonnes of corn for delivery on July 15, 1997, traders said.

Traders said KFPC was first introduced to the local market on Wednesday as another buying group such as Korea Feed Association (KFA). The KFPC consists of members of feed mill companies including Shindongbang Corp and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd which had bought their corn needs through the Korea Feed Association.
